source_doc: ecs-architecture.md v1.6, section 4.3 (v1.3 body split). DRAFT - first-pass values taken only from the doc; tune in simulation per section 9.
note: No single constitution modifier (v1.3). Body is three layers: systems -> organs -> tissues, each a BodyPart sub-entity. Organ health = BodyPart.hp / max_hp. Brain or heart at zero = death, no need to wait for whole-body hp to reach zero.

organs_v1.name: 脑
organs_v1.on_damage: 反应和智力下降；效用 AI 打分里的 personality 项受影响

organs_v1.name: 肾
organs_v1.on_damage: 毒素排不出去，持续掉血

tissues.name: 毛发
tissues.on_damage: 血量低、功能弱，主要是可烧、可剪、可留痕；烧了头发事件日志记一条；毛发会慢慢长回来

tissues.name: 血管
tissues.on_damage: 受伤流血，每 tick 按伤口大小掉血，包扎止血
